title: Dengue Seroprevalence, Mutational Dynamics & Clinical Correlation
shortDescription: Comprehensive surveillance correlating clinical disease severity with DENV lineage shifts, host seroprevalence, and in vivo murine challenge models.
keyHighlights: Serological profiling and antibody neutralization kinetics across longitudinal clinical cohorts.
Genomic surveillance identifying lineage-specific single nucleotide variants (SNVs) linked to severe dengue phenotypes.
Translational validation utilizing immunocompromised/adapted mouse models to dissect viral pathogenesis and vascular permeability.

title: Chikungunya Genetic Variations, Mutational Trajectories & Disease Severity
shortDescription: Investigating CHIKV structural and non-structural polyprotein mutations, mapping lineage divergences, and dissecting their mechanistic links to acute vs. chronic arthralgia.
keyHighlights: Targeted sequencing of envelope glycoproteins (E1/E2) to track fitness-enhancing adaptive mutations.
Association mapping between patient viral load, pro-inflammatory cytokine signatures, and chronic joint debilitation.
Comparative pathogenesis modeling examining cell tropism and viral replication efficiency across emergent lineages.

title: Atomic-Scale Structural Profiling of SARS-CoV-2 Immune Evasion & Receptor Binding
shortDescription: High-resolution computational docking and thermodynamic profiling elucidating the structural biophysics of spike mutation-driven antibody evasion and ACE2 binding affinity.
keyHighlights: All-atom protein-protein docking of monoclonal neutralizing antibodies against ancestral and evolving subvariants (BA.4/5, JN.1, KP lineages).
Per-residue interfacial contact mapping, buried surface area (BSA) quantification, and binding free energy (ΔG) calculations.
Decoupling the structural trade-offs between ACE2 high-affinity preservation and broad humoral escape mutations.

title: Molecular Mechanisms & Elicitor-Mediated Induction of Agarwood Resin in Aquilaria malaccensis
shortDescription: Elucidating the biochemical cascades, terpene synthase activation, and molecular pathways governing artificial agarwood oleoresin synthesis.
keyHighlights: Profiling differential expression of critical terpene synthases (TPS) and signaling pathways during artificial chemical and physical wound induction.
Characterizing the volatile and semi-volatile sesquiterpene metabolite spectrum of induced resinous heartwood.
Optimizing reproducible, high-efficiency elicitation formulations for sustainable industrial resin production.

title: Rational Immunogen Design of a Chimeric Multi-Epitope Pan-Dengue Vaccine
shortDescription: In silico structure-guided reverse vaccinology engineering chimeric immunogens capable of eliciting broad cross-neutralizing antibody titers across DENV-1–4 without ADE risk.
keyHighlights: Conserved, neutralizing B-cell and CD4+/CD8+ T-cell epitope mapping across DENV envelope domain III (EDIII) and non-structural protein 1 (NS1).
Structural scaffolding using flexible linkers and molecular adjuvants designed to suppress antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE).
Molecular dynamics simulation and in silico immune response modeling predicting humoral and cellular protective longevity.

title: Preclinical Immunogenicity & Protective Efficacy of a Recombinant JEV Subunit Vaccine
shortDescription: Development, expression, and in vivo murine immunogenicity assessment of novel Japanese Encephalitis Virus recombinant subunit candidates formulated with nano-adjuvants.
keyHighlights: Recombinant expression and purity verification of JEV envelope domain antigen targets.
In vivo immunization schedules in BALB/c mice evaluating humoral IgG subclass polarization (IgG1 vs. IgG2a) and T-cell responses.
Assessment of plaque reduction neutralization titers (PRNT50) and protective efficacy against viral challenge.
